SELECT c.chunk_id AS chunkId, c.document_id AS documentId, doc.document_type AS target, CAST(doc.document_id AS CHAR) AS externalId, doc.title AS title, doc.source_org AS agencyName, CASE WHEN doc.document_type = 'official_doc' THEN '공식 가이드 문서' WHEN doc.document_type = 'internal_doc' THEN '내부 지침/매뉴얼' WHEN doc.document_type = 'reference_doc' THEN '참고자료' ELSE doc.document_type END AS categoryName, doc.published_date AS sourceDate, NULL AS effectiveStatus, c.chunk_no AS chunkNo, c.chunk_title AS chunkTitle, c.chunk_text AS chunkText, c.page_no AS pageNo, c.source_path AS sourcePath, COALESCE(c.source_url, doc.source_url, doc.file_path) AS sourceUrl, c.sort_order AS sortOrder, c.content_hash AS contentHash, c.parent_section_title AS parentSectionTitle, c.section_type AS sectionType, c.quality_status AS qualityStatus FROM rag_document_chunks c JOIN rag_documents doc ON doc.document_id = c.document_id LEFT JOIN rag_chunk_embeddings e ON e.chunk_id = c.chunk_id AND e.embedding_model = #{model} AND e.vector_store = #{vectorStore} WHERE doc.use_yn = 'Y' AND c.use_yn = 'Y' AND AND AND (#{target} = '' OR doc.document_type = #{target}) AND ( #{query} = '' OR doc.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%') OR doc.source_org LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%') OR doc.document_category LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%') OR doc.document_topic LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%') OR c.chunk_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%') OR c.chunk_title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%') OR c.parent_section_title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%') OR c.embedding_text LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%') OR c.chunk_text LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%') ) AND ( e.chunk_id IS NULL OR ( e.status IN ('FAILED', 'ERROR') AND ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM semantic_batch_job_chunks bjc WHERE bjc.target = doc.document_type AND bjc.chunk_id = c.chunk_id AND bjc.status = 'FAILED' ) < 3 ) OR COALESCE(e.content_hash, '') != COALESCE(c.content_hash, '') ) ORDER BY CASE WHEN #{query} != '' AND doc.title = #{query} THEN 0 WHEN #{query} != '' AND doc.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%') THEN 1 WHEN #{query} != '' AND c.chunk_title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%') THEN 2 WHEN #{query} != '' AND c.parent_section_title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%') THEN 3 WHEN #{query} != '' AND c.embedding_text LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%') THEN 4 WHEN #{query} != '' AND c.chunk_text LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%') THEN 5 ELSE 4 END, doc.document_type, c.chunk_id LIMIT #{limit}

WITH document_matches AS ( SELECT doc.document_id, doc.document_type, doc.title, LOWER(REGEXP_REPLACE(doc.title, '[^0-9A-Za-z가-힣]', '')) AS normalized_title, MAX(
CASE WHEN LOWER(REGEXP_REPLACE(doc.title, '[^0-9A-Za-z가-힣]', '')) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(REGEXP_REPLACE(#{titleTerm}, '[^0-9A-Za-z가-힣]', '')), '%') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
) AS matched_title_term_count, MAX(CASE WHEN
LOWER(REGEXP_REPLACE(doc.title, '[^0-9A-Za-z가-힣]', '')) = LOWER(REGEXP_REPLACE(#{titleTerm}, '[^0-9A-Za-z가-힣]', ''))
THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS exact_title_match,
MAX(CASE WHEN
LOWER(REGEXP_REPLACE(COALESCE(c.chunk_no, ''), '[^0-9A-Za-z가-힣]', '')) = LOWER(REGEXP_REPLACE(#{provisionTerm}, '[^0-9A-Za-z가-힣]', '')) OR LOWER(REGEXP_REPLACE(COALESCE(c.chunk_title, ''), '[^0-9A-Za-z가-힣]', '')) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(REGEXP_REPLACE(#{provisionTerm}, '[^0-9A-Za-z가-힣]', '')), '%') OR LOWER(REGEXP_REPLACE(COALESCE(c.parent_section_title, ''), '[^0-9A-Za-z가-힣]', '')) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(REGEXP_REPLACE(#{provisionTerm}, '[^0-9A-Za-z가-힣]', '')), '%')
THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
0 AS provision_anchor_match FROM rag_documents doc JOIN rag_document_chunks c ON c.document_id = doc.document_id WHERE doc.use_yn = 'Y' AND c.use_yn = 'Y' AND AND AND doc.document_type IN
#{target}
GROUP BY doc.document_id, doc.document_type, doc.title ) SELECT document_id AS documentId, document_type AS target, title, normalized_title AS normalizedTitle, matched_title_term_count AS matchedTitleTermCount, exact_title_match AS exactTitleMatch, provision_anchor_match AS provisionAnchorMatch FROM document_matches WHERE (
normalized_title = LOWER(REGEXP_REPLACE(#{titleTerm}, '[^0-9A-Za-z가-힣]', ''))
OR (
normalized_title LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(REGEXP_REPLACE(#{titleTerm}, '[^0-9A-Za-z가-힣]', '')), '%')
) ) ORDER BY exactTitleMatch DESC, matchedTitleTermCount DESC, provisionAnchorMatch DESC, documentId LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT COUNT(*) AS currentIndexedCount, CONCAT( LPAD(HEX(BIT_XOR(CAST(CONV(SUBSTRING(e.revision_hash, 1, 16), 16, 10) AS UNSIGNED))), 16, '0'), LPAD(HEX(BIT_XOR(CAST(CONV(SUBSTRING(e.revision_hash, 17, 16), 16, 10) AS UNSIGNED))), 16, '0'), LPAD(HEX(BIT_XOR(CAST(CONV(SUBSTRING(e.revision_hash, 33, 16), 16, 10) AS UNSIGNED))), 16, '0'), LPAD(HEX(BIT_XOR(CAST(CONV(SUBSTRING(e.revision_hash, 49, 16), 16, 10) AS UNSIGNED))), 16, '0') ) AS contentFingerprint, COALESCE( DATE_FORMAT( MAX(GREATEST(doc.updated_at, c.updated_at, e.updated_at)), '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.%f' ), '' ) AS updatedWatermark FROM rag_chunk_embeddings e JOIN rag_document_chunks c ON c.chunk_id = e.chunk_id JOIN rag_documents doc ON doc.document_id = c.document_id WHERE doc.use_yn = 'Y' AND c.use_yn = 'Y' AND COALESCE(c.quality_status, 'PASS') IN ('PASS', 'REVIEW') AND c.chunk_version = ( SELECT MAX(c2.chunk_version) FROM rag_document_chunks c2 WHERE c2.document_id = c.document_id AND c2.use_yn = 'Y' AND COALESCE(c2.quality_status, 'PASS') IN ('PASS', 'REVIEW') ) AND e.embedding_model = #{model} AND e.vector_store = #{vectorStore} AND e.status = 'INDEXED' AND e.content_hash = c.content_hash AND e.revision_hash IS NOT NULL AND c.content_hash REGEXP '^[0-9A-Fa-f]{64}$'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO rag_chunk_embeddings ( chunk_id, embedding_model, vector_store, vector_point_id, content_hash, revision_hash, status, embedded_at, last_error_message ) VALUES ( #{chunkId}, #{model}, #{vectorStore}, #{vectorPointId}, #{contentHash}, SHA2(CONCAT(CAST(#{chunkId} AS CHAR), ':', #{contentHash}), 256), #{status}, NOW(), #{errorMessage} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE vector_point_id = VALUES(vector_point_id), content_hash = VALUES(content_hash), revision_hash = VALUES(revision_hash), status = VALUES(status), embedded_at = VALUES(embedded_at), last_error_message = VALUES(last_error_message)
mapper.update: UPDATE rag_documents doc SET import_status = 'INDEXED', last_error_message = NULL, imported_at = NOW() WHERE doc.document_type = #{documentType} AND doc.use_yn = 'Y' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM rag_document_chunks c LEFT JOIN rag_chunk_embeddings e ON e.chunk_id = c.chunk_id AND e.embedding_model = #{model} AND e.vector_store = #{vectorStore} WHERE c.document_id = doc.document_id AND c.use_yn = 'Y' AND AND AND ( e.chunk_id IS NULL OR e.status != 'INDEXED' OR COALESCE(e.content_hash, '') != COALESCE(c.content_hash, '') ) )

UPDATE rag_chunk_embeddings e JOIN rag_document_chunks c ON c.chunk_id = e.chunk_id JOIN rag_documents doc ON doc.document_id = c.document_id SET e.status = 'FAILED', e.last_error_message = 'Recovered stale BATCH_SUBMITTED without active batch job.', e.updated_at = NOW() WHERE e.embedding_model = #{model} AND e.vector_store = #{vectorStore} AND e.status = 'BATCH_SUBMITTED' AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, e.embedded_at, NOW()) >= #{staleMinutes} AND (#{documentType} = '' OR doc.document_type = #{documentType}) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM semantic_batch_job_chunks bjc JOIN semantic_batch_jobs bj ON bj.batch_job_id = bjc.batch_job_id WHERE bjc.chunk_id = e.chunk_id AND bj.target = doc.document_type AND bj.status IN ('validating', 'in_progress', 'finalizing') )
